title: NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ: NVDA) — Institutional Investment Dossier
primer: NVIDIA is an AI computing compounder with $115.8B Q3 FY27 revenue, 74.23% ROIC, and $96.68B FY26 FCF. The stock trades at 7.56x Forward P/E after a 48.42% drop from its $243.37 peak. After Jensen Huang’s Nov 12 exit and a Nov 20 SEC inquiry, NVDA fell to $125.53. While the quantitative facts ledger tags NVDA Stage 1 (Basing) near 52-week lows, stage2_evaluation classifies it STAGE_4 (AVOID_STAGE4_OR_BROKEN) below falling 50D/200D/30W averages. We rate NVDA WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT, bidding $105–$118 with a $96 stop or a Feb 2027 $125/$215 call spread.
holding_rationale: Verified 0 shares held across Charles Schwab ($44,634.37 equities, $22.43 cash) and Robinhood ($13,057.44 equities, $2,517.92 cash) as of 2026-11-20. NVDA is in an active Stage 4 breakdown (38.27% below 200D SMA $203.35, 1D RSI 15.05, CAP_REJECTED) inside a Downtrend S&P 500 (35.8% breadth >50DMA, 10 distribution days), while our portfolio already carries 2.34x weighted beta. We keep 100% of marginal US cash sidelined and wait for a Stage 1 base in $105.00-$118.00 (2.59:1 asymmetry to $175.00 vs $96.00 stop).
